title: Default settings for All-in-One Spark Ads
content_data:
The following table lists the default settings for All-in-One Spark Ads (Spark Ads created using [/business/spark_ad/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1829744071179330)). Note that the default settings vary based on your objective_type and optimization_goal. To learn more about these parameters with default values, see their field descriptions in [/campaign/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739315828649986), [/adgroup/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739314558673922), and [/ad/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1735735588640770).
